name: Toyo Kanetsu K.K.
summary: Toyo Kanetsu K.K. engages in plant and machinery, logistics systems, and other businesses in Japan, Southeast Asia, and internationally. The company operates through Logistics Solutions Business, Plant Business, and Business Innovation and Incubation segments. The Logistics Solutions segment develops, designs, and manufactures logistics systems centered on sorting, picking, and transportation systems that integrate IT, and performs maintenance systems. The Plant segment is engaged in the maintenance of storage tanks for LNG, LPG, crude oil, and other gases and liquids.
